tablet.notes: New messages now have a Mute button next to Reply and Mark as read. It opens that chat's mute choices: snooze for 1, 8 or 24 hours on this tablet, or mute until you turn it back on, which also mutes it on the flip phone.

tablet-regular.notes:
Hold a message: the whole screen goes soft, emoji reactions sit above it and a card of actions below (Forward, Copy, Delete, Select more, Info), like Google Messages. Select more and the Details page match too.
The keyboard closes after you send and when you swipe through the messages. The voice recorder is much smaller. The tablet icon on messages another tablet sent no longer goes missing.
Fixed a crash when opening a video that had been downloaded ahead.
Since the last update: bubbles stop at about three quarters of the width.

messageplus.notes: The flip phone now tells the tablet which Wi-Fi network it is on.

messageplus_previous.notes: Stopping a sync from the tablet now reaches the flip phone at once: it listens for the Stop instead of checking every few seconds while a sync runs.

tablet2.notes:
Fixes messages showing twice after the phone's history sync, and makes opening the app with a large message history much faster (the cleanup of those copies no longer scans every message again and again).
Also in this copy: the Performance log (Settings > Performance log), and group texts from a new group start their own group.
